issues.description: @DID-Lab-SZU @hiroki-chen @Marsman1996. I find this modification is unsound. `frame_obligations` is used to track the `DropObligations` (which is also tracked) that are given to frames. If we change this field to ghost, then `MetaRegionOwners` will lose this track because it can be arbitrarily modified.
issues.rationale: Public ghost frame_obligations:Multiset is freely mutable without consuming outstanding DropObligation tokens. inv() does not constrain the ledger; clean_inv only checks it is empty. A caller can empty the ghost ledger while retaining linear tokens, defeating the claimed clean-boundary accounting. Source even marks machinery unsound at274. This is accounting-model unsoundness, not a claim of SMT logical inconsistency.

issues.description: The verification change rewrites an existing to_flat_binary comment instead of preserving the original source documentation.
issues.rationale: The base contains the original two-line comment about mem_size exceeding file_size and zero filling. The selected head replaces it with an explanation about overlapping segments while leaving the adjacent executable resize/copy logic unchanged. The preserve-exec-code guideline at this same head requires existing comments and rustdoc to be preserved verbatim during proof work, with apparent documentation corrections handled separately. Review comment 4582797497 explicitly requests preserving the comment. Subsequent commit d30c271708585a0ae89b5eafd1dd795bc98281a9 restores the original wording. This label concerns the scope and preservation rule, not a claim that the replacement comment is semantically false.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Compared base/head code, pinned preserve-exec-code guideline, full PR discussion, and subsequent restoration commit d30c271708585a0ae89b5eafd1dd795bc98281a9.
